source: wt-webux2 branch web/ux-social-1016: src/lib/mob/model.mjs (buildView, errors, copy), src/lib/server/mob/service.js, src/lib/server/mob/http.js, src/app/api/mob/**
fixtures: Byte-for-byte copies of wt-webux2 data/tests/fixtures/mob/*.json (data/tests/mob.test.mjs fails if the route functions stop producing them). Copy them to flutter_app/test/fixtures/mob/ and parse them in unit tests. The same bodies are inlined under fixtureBodies below.
flag: MOB_ENABLED must be "true" on the server; otherwise every route below answers 404 { error: { code: "MOB_DISABLED" } }. Off in production until the owner answers D-S1.
staging: Migration 20261017100000_mob is applied on staging onwkqxmjqjrhfbjjdydu (16 Oct 2026) and kept there for the app walk. Not applied to production.
auth: Every route except GET /api/mob/join/<code> needs a signed-in session: the app sends Authorization: Bearer <app token> exactly as for /api/sessions. Routes answer OPTIONS with the native CORS headers (mobileOptions).

envelope.error: { "error": { "code": string, "message": string } }. message is a plain sentence a student can read; show it as is. Unknown codes: treat as UNAVAILABLE.
envelope.rateLimited: 429 RATE_LIMITED with a Retry-After header in seconds.

rules: Members are addressed only by memberId (12 Crockford characters, an HMAC of mob and user). User ids never appear.
members[] is in join order. Never sort it, never by score.
score appears on a member only when that member chose to show it (and always on your own entry once you sat): { value, of }, shown as "7 of 10".
The ring: week.size segments, week.sat filled, in join order. Never label an unfilled segment; never list who has not sat.
trap is null unless you sat and 3 or more members sat. It never names who picked the option.
nudge.received is the one preset note ("<fromName> sat it and asked you to sit it too."). Mark it seen with POST /api/mob/nudge/seen.

week.paper.cost is the server's charge type for the paper (the same as a quick 10 today; owner decision D-S2). Draw the cost line under the sit button before the tap. null means you already sat or the cost could not be read: draw nothing.
week.closed is true when a paper started now could not finish before Sunday 11:59 PM IST: show the closed line and no sit button.
Times are shown in 12-hour IST ("Fri 23 Oct, 9:40 PM"). No arrows, no exclamation marks.
TODO(owner D-S4): nothing grants, spends or rewards credits for invites. Build no reward.

request.subject: string (a launchable CUET subject id, e.g. "accountancy")
request.name: string, 2 to 18, ^[\p{L}][\p{L}\p{M} .'-]{1,17}$

response.200: { code, url, expiresAt, usesLeft }  (a new link revokes the previous one; url is https://www.mockmob.in/join/<code>)
{ valid: true, code, subject, subjectName, size, seatsLeft, expiresAt }  (never a name)

request.code: string (8 Crockford characters; O reads as 0, I and L as 1)
request.name: string

routes.note: to is a count only and can be 0.

request.startReceipt: string? (the receipt from an earlier start, to resume after a lost draft)

response.200: Exactly the POST /api/sessions practice-start response (questions, meta with sessionTicket or the durable session). Finish it with PATCH /api/sessions as any practice; the server records the sitting.

routes.note: The server derives the generation key per member and week, so a retry resumes the same session and is never charged twice. Every member gets the same question ids in the same option order.

mobView.subject: string
mobView.you: { memberId, name, colour, role: "owner"|"member", showScore, nudgesMuted }
mobView.members: [{ memberId, name, colour, you, sat, score?: { value, of }, owner?: true }]  join order
mobView.week: { start: "YYYY-MM-DD" (IST Monday), closesAt: ISO, closed, paper: { count: 10, durationSec: 720, cost: { type: "included"|"allowance"|"credits", credits?, balance? } | null }, sat, size, youSat, yourResultId: string|null }

changes_1017.note: 17 Oct 2026 Mob fix round (go/no-go NO-GO 6/10 -> fixes on branch web/mob-fix-1017, worktree wt-mobfix). These override the sections above where they differ. The byte-exact fixtures are wt-mobfix data/tests/fixtures/mob/*.json (data/tests/mob.test.mjs regenerates and checks them); copy them to flutter_app/test/fixtures/mob/.
changes_1017.staging: Migration 20261017190000_mob_fix_1017 (undo supabase/undo/20261017190000_mob_fix_1017.undo.sql) is applied on staging onwkqxmjqjrhfbjjdydu. Not on production.

plans.free: Start ONE Mob (counted over Mobs you started and are still in) and join ANY number by invite, up to a safety ceiling of 12 memberships. One free weekly Mob paper a week across all Mobs (week.paper.blocked = free_used in the others).
plans.pro: Start up to 3 Mobs; side-by-side, history, extra papers.
plans.freeInProMob: A free member of a Pro-made Mob sits its extra papers (POST /api/mob/paper { mob, extra }) at no cost; making extras stays Pro.
plans.viewFields: mob.plan = { pro, maxMobs, mobCount, started, canMakeExtra, canStartAnother }. canStartAnother = started < maxMobs && mobCount < 12. Show Start another Mob from canStartAnother only; never decide the plan on the device.

changes_1017.sharing: Sharing inside a Mob (score, picks, times, changed answers; only to that Mob) is ON by default: you.showScore is true for new members and existing rows were moved once. The switch stays (PATCH /api/mob/me { showScore }). Label: Share my score and answers with my Mob. The app must default the switch from you.showScore, never assume off, and say before join/start that members see each other's answers and scores and one switch turns yours off. Side-by-side shows another member only when both share (reciprocal).
changes_1017.paper: week.paper.durationSec is 600 (10 questions x 60 s, the runner clock). Copy: 10 questions, 10 minutes. Never about 12 min.
changes_1017.invitesPaused: When MOB_INVITES_ENABLED=false: GET /api/mob sends mob.invitesPaused = true and mob.invite = null; POST /api/mob/invite answers INVITES_PAUSED; GET /api/mob/join/<code> and POST /api/mob/join answer JOIN_PAUSED. Show the message; hide Invite.
changes_1017.chapters: GET /api/mob/extra?mob=<id> (Pro) -> { mobId, lengths: [5,10,15,20], chapters: [{ chapter, ready, longest }] }: only chapters the paper selector can really build, fullest first; longest is the longest extra paper for that chapter. Label options "<chapter>, up to <longest> questions" and disable longer lengths.
changes_1017.errorEnvelope: { error: { code, message, detail? } }. message may be more specific than the code's default (the real wait, the real lengths): show error.message as given. detail is data the screen can act on (BANK_THIN: { ready, asked, suggest: { chapter|null, count } | null }).
changes_1017.rateLimited: 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After in seconds = the real wait, and a message that names it (for example You can start another on Fri 23 Oct, 9:40 PM). Starting a Mob and making an extra paper count only when they succeed.

NO_SUBJECTS.message: Choose your CUET subjects first. A Mob sits one paper a week in one of them.

MOB_FULL.message: This Mob is full: it has 5 members, the most a Mob can have. Ask your friend to tell you if a seat opens, or start a Mob of your own.

MOB_LIMIT.message: You already started a Mob. Free lets you start one, and join as many as friends invite you to. Pro lets you start up to 3.

MOB_LIMIT_PRO.message: You already started 3 Mobs, the most Pro allows. You can still join any Mob a friend invites you to.

MOB_CEILING.message: You are in 12 Mobs, the most one account can be in. Leave one to start or join another.

INVITES_PAUSED.message: New invites are paused for now. Your Mob works as before.

JOIN_PAUSED.message: Joining a Mob by link is paused for now. Try this link again later.

WEEK_INVALID.message: There is no Mob paper for that week.

EXTRA_NOT_FOUND.message: That extra paper is not in your Mob.

COMPARE_SIT_FIRST.message: Sit this paper first, then you can compare it with your Mob.

NOT_SAT_THAT_WEEK.message: You did not sit that week's paper, so there is nothing of yours to compare.

COMPARE_PAST_ALONE.message: Only one member sat that week's paper, so there is nothing to compare.

BANK_THIN.message: There are not enough questions ready for that paper.

RATE_LIMITED.message: Too many tries in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.

errorHandling.NO_SUBJECTS: POST /api/mob when the account has no subjects: show the message with one key to choose subjects (web: /onboarding?edit=true&back=/mob), then come back to the start form.
errorHandling.SUBJECT_INVALID: subject is not one of the account's own subjects: offer only user.subjects as chips.
errorHandling.MOB_FULL: lookup or join of a Mob with 5 members: its own screen (This Mob is full) with Start your own Mob; never the expired-link copy.
errorHandling.MOB_LIMIT: free student who already started a Mob: say they can still join any Mob by invite; offer Pro quietly.
errorHandling.BANK_THIN: show error.message and, when detail.suggest, one key: Make a <count>-question paper on <chapter or the whole subject>.

changes_1017.entryPoints: Web (for parity): Today one calm line after the move and the rows for a member (ring + one outlined key: Sit it / See your Mob / Invite a friend), Practice one line (Mob paper, <Subject>, 10 questions, 10 minutes + Sit it, or Sat + See your answers), Review one row only after you sat (the Mob trap row, else the teaser line). Non-members: Today only, one inline invitation after a real moment (a study week met or 7 saved sessions), dismissable for good, gone after 7 days; never a pop-up, never during a paper. One volt per screen: entry keys are outlined. App equivalents: Today card below the road, Practice row, Review row, You hub row (Your Mob / Start a Mob).
